license.notes: The NTRS record marks the conference paper Public Use Permitted. This manifest records extracted aggregate parameters only; it does not redistribute or claim access to raw MADS records.

domain_gaps: the paper publishes MADS-derived aggregates rather than raw event and exposure records
ISS hardware, gravity, logistics, accessibility, duty cycles, and maintenance staffing differ from a Mars base
the preliminary database is explicitly incomplete and representative rows do not form a complete reliability block diagram
reported repair durations exclude some gathering, stowing, troubleshooting, scheduling, and access delays

partitions.name: profile_development
partitions.selector: source tables 2, 8, 9, and 10 with explicit row identity

partitions.name: sensitivity_validation
partitions.purpose: test uncertainty and alternate Mars duty-cycle assumptions without refitting source values
partitions.selector: scenario seeds with stable_hash(seed) modulo 5 in [3,4]

prohibited_claims: published tables are the raw ISS Maintenance and Analysis Data Set
representative ORU rows are a complete ECLSS reliability model
ISS rates are exact future Mars-base failure probabilities
reference MTTR values include all operational delay and logistics time
